answer: Bonded entry: each new agent must lock a 50 POA deposit for 30 days before it can earn. If peers flag it as a duplicate, the bond is slashed and paid to the reporters. Like planting an orchard, value comes slowly, so a sybil farm of 1,000 fake agents ties up 50,000 POA and risks losing it all. That cost grows in a spiral as detection improves, turning cheap identities into an expensive pearl few attackers can afford.
